# NxtDuo

> NxtDuo is a small, independent, two-person app studio making apps for families around the world. It builds small, careful products for everyday life: apps, games and tools in local languages, with no dark patterns and no selling of user data.

Contact: support@nxtduo.com
Website: https://nxtduo.com/

## Apps

- [Talk With Swamy](https://nxtduo.com/talk-with-swamy/): A quiet chat on the teachings of Sri Ramana Maharshi. Ask in your own words; it answers in his calm style, using only passages from his recorded words in 10 books, and names the book each answer comes from. Status: Live on the web & iPhone. Free on the web and the App Store. Android is coming soon. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/talk-with-swamy/privacy/
- [NxtDue](https://nxtduo.com/nxtdue/): Vehicle insurance, PUC, passports, subscriptions, warranties: add them once and NxtDue reminds you in time, with notifications that actually arrive. No ads, no data selling. Status: Live on iPhone & Android. Free on the App Store and Google Play. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/nxtdue/privacy/
- [PassOn](https://nxtduo.com/passon/): Can't use your movie or event ticket? List it on PassOn and give it free to someone who needs one. You chat on PassOn without sharing your phone number. PassOn never handles money. Status: Live on the web. Free at passon.nxtduo.com. The App Store and Google Play apps are coming soon. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/passon/privacy/
- [Publik](https://nxtduo.com/publik/): A free guide to about 1,880 public spaces in Bengaluru: parks, playgrounds, lakes, libraries and public toilets, with timings, directions, "open now" and "near me". Visitors can add photos and notes, and flag a place that is under repair. Status: Live. Free on the web at publik.nxtduo.com. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/publik/privacy/
- [Meter Mele](https://nxtduo.com/meter-mele/): Drive an auto through streets built from real map data. Pick up passengers and get them there before the meter beats you. Potholes, rain, night rides and leaderboards, in the browser on any phone or laptop. Status: Live · Play free. Free in your browser at meter-mele.pages.dev. Privacy policy: https://nxtduo.com/meter-mele/privacy/
